start.card:
Class A has 10 students who averaged 70 on a test. Class B has 30 students who averaged 90.
If we put all 40 students together, what is their average score? Make a guess first.
start.title: Average of two classes

afterGuess.card:
You picked: 80 (halfway between 70 and 90).
Let's test it. Each dot is one student. Slide the balance point along the scores until the two sides pull equally.
